alert_news.title: India's First Dedicated Green Methanol Bunkering Facility at V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Thoothukudi
bullets: India’s first dedicated green methanol bunkering facility located at V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Thoothukudi, inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on 11 October 2026.
Storage capacity of 1,500 cubic metres (two 750 m³ tanks) linked by a 2.8‑km stainless steel pipeline; two transfer pumps of 120 m³/h each, enabling 1.2 lakh litres per hour.
Project implemented under the National Green Hydrogen Mission; Ministry of New and Renewable Energy allocated ₹35.34 crore; VOCPA is the implementing agency.

alert_news.title: Dhinidhi Desinghu wins India's first Youth Olympic swimming bronze - The News Mill
bullets: First Youth Olympic swimming medal for India – bronze in women's 100 m freestyle at Dakar 2026, won by Dhinidhi Desinghu
First Indian swimmer to reach a Youth Olympic final and podium; set a national record of 56.27 seconds

alert_news.title: Hyderabad startup opens India's first private space debris removal facility
bullets: India's first private space‑debris removal and satellite servicing test facility, named Base 1, inaugurated in Hyderabad by Cosmoserve Space
Facility includes Orbital Rendezvous & Capture Lab, Space Robotics Innovation Lab, ISO‑Class 8 clean room and Mission Simulation Centre; aims for commercial debris‑removal missions by early 2028
